latestVersion.changelog:
**v1.0.3 summary:**  
Now includes all 179 agent profiles pre-configured and ready to use out of the box.

- Bundled 179 professional agents as `data/agents.json`
- Automated agent data import during database initialization
- Added `scripts/import_agents.py` for manual (re-)import if needed
- Updated `init_database.py` to auto-load agent data from JSON
- Improved documentation to reflect bundled agents and simplified setup
- Removed manual agent import instructions; no external steps required
